usage: Seed references for ViberMode game-reference-benchmark artifacts. Refresh with current store/chart research during each serious game pass.

references.name: Snake Clash!
signals: App Store listing observed 724K ratings, 4.7 score, and Chart #17 Simulation on 2026-07-05.
Google Play listing observed 100M+ downloads, 4.3 star, and 1M+ reviews on 2026-07-05.
references.coreVerb: Slither, eat, grow, and survive against rivals.
references.firstTenSeconds: Player should understand movement, food collection, rival avoidance, and growth immediately.
references.pressure: Bigger rivals, arena competition, boss/milestone pressure, short-session survival.
references.visualHook: Large readable snake body, growth scale, arena field, collectible food, skin identity.
references.feedbackHook: Eating creates visible growth, stronger presence, opponent defeat, reward/currency feedback.
references.progressionPromise: Skins, upgrades, bosses, seasonal events, rankings, offline/online modes.
references.doNotCopy: Do not clone snake IP, fake multiplayer presentation, ad pressure, or exact arena/skin treatment.
references.benchmarkUse: Use for growth-loop clarity, body/silhouette identity, and instant eat-grow feedback.

references.name: Block Blast!
signals: App Store listing observed 2.6M ratings, 4.9 score, and Chart #5 Casual on 2026-07-05.
Official site claims 70M daily active users and 300M monthly active users on 2026-07-05.
references.coreVerb: Drag blocks, place them on a grid, clear lines, chase high score.
references.firstTenSeconds: Player should see grid, draggable pieces, and row/column clearing affordance.
references.pressure: Spatial scarcity, future-piece planning, no-move failure, daily puzzle goals.
references.visualHook: Bright cube materials, 8x8 grid, satisfying block crush and color burst.
references.feedbackHook: Line clears explode, cascades reward good placement, score/high-score loop reinforces mastery.
references.progressionPromise: Daily puzzles, endless high-score chase, adventure or mode variety.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy exact block shapes, board art, branding, or puzzle layout.
references.benchmarkUse: Use for board readability, immediate puzzle affordance, and satisfying clear feedback.

references.name: Pizza Ready!
signals: App Store listing observed 325K ratings, 4.6 score, and Chart #22 Simulation on 2026-07-05.
references.coreVerb: Cook, serve, clean, upgrade, and expand a restaurant.
references.firstTenSeconds: Player should understand the station, customer queue, serving route, and upgrade loop.
references.pressure: Customer demand, service speed, staff capacity, station throughput, expansion goals.
references.visualHook: Readable restaurant stations, food production line, customers, staff, upgradeable space.
references.feedbackHook: Serving converts to cash/progress, upgrades visibly speed or expand operations.
references.progressionPromise: Counter plus drive-thru, staff hiring, decoration, chain expansion, events.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy restaurant theme, pizza assets, store layout, or idle economy tuning.
references.benchmarkUse: Use for cozy operational loops, object-world clarity, and visible upgrade surfaces.

references.name: Hole.io
signals: App Store listing observed 2M ratings and 4.6 score on 2026-07-05.
references.coreVerb: Glide a hole, swallow objects, grow, and clear the map.
references.firstTenSeconds: Player should see a controllable hole, nearby small objects, and size-gated targets.
references.pressure: Object size gating, map timer/clear pressure, rival scale in competitive variants.
references.visualHook: Black hole silhouette, city/object scale contrast, growing radius, object collapse.
references.feedbackHook: Swallowing objects creates crunch, disappearance, growth, and map-clearing satisfaction.
references.progressionPromise: New maps, collections, clearer UI, map progress, object variety.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy black-hole theme, city maps, or exact swallow mechanic.
references.benchmarkUse: Use for single-object screenshot read, satisfying scale progression, and tactile destruction feedback.

references.name: Going Balls
signals: App Store listing describes a fast-paced rolling-ball track game; refresh chart/rating data during use.
references.coreVerb: Guide a rolling ball across tracks to the finish.
references.firstTenSeconds: Player should understand swipe/tilt control, track path, finish direction, and falling risk.
references.pressure: Narrow tracks, obstacles, physics, speed, precision, level completion.
references.visualHook: Shiny ball, elevated track, obstacle silhouettes, forward camera momentum.
references.feedbackHook: Rolling speed, collision, fall/retry, finish celebration, level progression.
references.progressionPromise: Increasingly difficult tracks, skins, obstacle variety, mastery runs.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy track layouts, ball skins, or exact physics presentation.
references.benchmarkUse: Use for one-object control feel, obstacle readability, and level-by-level skill pressure.
